description: Same checks as verify_email for a list, run in parallel with per-domain DNS caching; returns per-address results, a summary by status, and `clean` (the deliverable ones). Charged per unique address. Example: emails ['a@x.com','b@y.org'], smtp_check false. Response: result with status (deliverable | risky | undeliverable | invalid | unknown), reason, score 0–100, the checks run, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. No logging of addresses.

dedupe.description: Drop case-insensitive duplicates before checking (duplicates are not charged).
dedupe.title: Dedupe

smtp_check.description: SMTP RCPT TO probe per mailbox (slower; some servers block it).
smtp_check.title: Smtp Check
